purpose: Seeds replayed by tests/fuzz/test_fuzz.py. Every bug a fuzz run finds and fixes adds its target, seed and iteration count here with the fix it belongs to; the runs are deterministic, so a seed is a reproducer.

state_runs.note: baseline; 300 mutated states per session, with and without a disk. The only finding: DISK_update shifted the -1 of DSKSYNC(-1, v) left in every state load (UBSan), patch 0102
T23b: the A600 profile (1 MiB Chip, empty clock chunk). The first run found that a state loaded into an ECS Agnus left programmed_register_accessed_h set (patch 0104)
T24c: the A1200 profile (68EC020, AGA, 2 MiB Chip, the 68020 block of P6CP, CAGA and the Denise ring in the video chunk): mutated states of 2.2 MB each
T50: the A500 OG: no Slow RAM, no clock chunk (baseline; no defect found)
T50: the A500+: ECS Agnus, 1 MiB Chip, the clock chunk (baseline; no defect found)
T50: the A1000: the 8361 chips and the CTOD body of P6CH (patch 0240), no clock chunk (baseline; no defect found)
T50: the A2000 OG: Slow RAM, the clock chunk and the CTOD body (baseline; no defect found)
T50: the A2000: ECS Agnus with the OCS Denise, the clock chunk and the CTOD body (baseline; no defect found)

state_writable_runs.note: T27: states of a session with floppy writes (the overlay body of P6DK carries three runs of guest sectors) and p6_media_export / p6_media_write_status with hostile arguments

content_runs.note: baseline of T63a (decode_hard_file: .hdf and .hdz with cut, flipped, bad-trailer and oversized gzip members, a bomb at the cap, wrong sizes); no defect found
baseline of T63a; no defect found

baseline of T64a (the volume builder: trees with hostile names, LHA archives and ZIP files flipped, cut, claiming more than the caps, with names that leave the volume; an accepted source is an image that is exactly its tree); no defect found
baseline of T64a; no defect found

config_runs.note: found before the fix: a digit string of more than 4300 characters escaped normalize_config as a bare ValueError that named no option, and a request that was not a dict escaped as TypeError (an empty list was accepted as nothing requested); fixed in tools/generate_options.py
baseline after the fix; no defect found

hardfile_runs.note: baseline of T29d; 60 mutated hard files (RDSK, PART, FSHD and LSEG blocks), loaded, mounted by the micro-ROM, saved and loaded back. Findings: rdb_checksum summed the longs a block declared out of a one-block buffer (heap overflow read and an int overflow), and the log dumps of the RDB (dump_partinfo, dump_rdb) overflowed ints and divided by a block size of zero: patch 0190
